nodes.label: NOTE: This file should not be edited
nodes.norm_label: note: this file should not be edited

nodes.label: CI/CD Pipeline with Automated Tests
nodes.rationale: Manual SSH deploys are the main cause of self-inflicted downtime. Full e2e runs nightly/pre-release only, since a flaky pipeline the solo owner ignores is worse than none.

nodes.label: CloudWatch Metrics and Alarms
nodes.rationale: Zero-setup, cheap, already integrated with the managed services.

nodes.label: Containerised Deploy (Docker Compose on Single VM)
nodes.norm_label: containerised deploy (docker compose on single vm)
nodes.rationale: Identical artifact laptop to CI to production; rollback becomes a tag change; image drops into ECS/Fargate later with no rework.

nodes.label: ECS/Fargate (Tier 2 Ceiling)
nodes.rationale: Realistic ceiling of platform complexity; Kubernetes/EKS and service mesh explicitly out of scope as they solve multi-team coordination problems this product lacks.

nodes.label: External Uptime Check (UptimeRobot / Healthchecks.io)
nodes.rationale: Catches a fully-down box that cannot report on itself.

nodes.label: Managed RDS Database
nodes.rationale: Automated backups, point-in-time recovery, managed patching, one-click restore.

nodes.label: Monitoring and Alerting
nodes.rationale: Owner currently learns of outages from customers; also records request rate and p95 latency as evidence for Tier 2 scaling decisions.

nodes.label: Nightly Logical DB Dump to S3 + Restore Rehearsal
nodes.norm_label: nightly logical db dump to s3 + restore rehearsal
nodes.rationale: Defence-in-depth against replicated bad writes or account compromise; rehearse restore so runbook is real.

nodes.label: Owner-controlled Password Manager
nodes.rationale: So access never depends on one individual.

nodes.label: Secrets Management (SSM Parameter Store / Secrets Manager)
nodes.norm_label: secrets management (ssm parameter store / secrets manager)
nodes.rationale: Move secrets out of .env files on the box; injected at container start.

nodes.label: Sentry Frontend Error Tracking
nodes.rationale: CloudWatch has no visibility into client-side JS errors; free tier suffices.

nodes.label: Stateless VM (Move State to Managed Services)
nodes.norm_label: stateless vm (move state to managed services)
nodes.rationale: Highest-severity risk is the DB sharing an unmanaged disk; making the VM disposable makes CI/CD and IaC safe.

nodes.label: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
nodes.rationale: Terraform from day one rather than config management because definitions carry forward unchanged into Tier 2; in-VM setup is a minimal cloud-init script.

nodes.label: Tier 1 - Stabilise (Minimum Viable SDLC)
nodes.rationale: Top five changes; ~3-4 weeks of one engineer, ~$40-60/month added infra cost.

nodes.label: Tier 2 - Scale-up Playbook
nodes.rationale: Deferred until a concrete signal (revenue, traffic, second engineer) justifies cost and operational overhead: Multi-AZ RDS, ECS/Fargate, staging/per-PR envs, APM, CDN, compliance.

nodes.label: Version Control (Git + Hosted Repo + PR Checks)
nodes.norm_label: version control (git + hosted repo + pr checks)
nodes.rationale: Cheapest item and every other item depends on it; trunk-based with short-lived branches, no GitFlow (too heavy).

nodes.label: ALB + CloudFront Front Door
nodes.rationale: SSE needs un-buffered responses, so keep it on ALB rather than API Gateway; CloudFront for TLS.

nodes.label: In-process BullMQ Worker
nodes.rationale: Runs in the same process as the API, so a single ECS task definition covers both.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Local Stack
nodes.rationale: Local development convenience only, not the deployment target; per-app Dockerfiles are the real artifact.

nodes.label: Root dotenv Cascade
nodes.rationale: Single cascade (.env.<mode>.local, .env.local, .env.<mode>, .env) read by apps, Prisma CLI and compose; .env.local checked in so a direct run works with no setup.

nodes.label: Items API (/api/v1/items)
nodes.rationale: POST persists an item, emits item_submitted and enqueues on the items queue; GET lists paginated items with status.

nodes.label: ItemService.scoreItem Processing Stub
nodes.rationale: 2-second wait + score step written for this project since no stub was provided.

nodes.label: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 Uploads Directory
nodes.norm_label: mountpoint for amazon s3 uploads directory
nodes.rationale: Back <cwd>/uploads with an S3 mount so local-filesystem code is untouched; app writes whole objects once and reads sequentially, matching Mountpoint's supported pattern. Fallback: FileService swap to S3 SDK with presigned URLs.

nodes.label: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL Build Arg
nodes.rationale: Inlined into the web bundle at build time, so must be the browser-facing API origin, never an internal compose hostname.

nodes.label: Prisma + PostgreSQL Persistence
nodes.rationale: Schema applied via prisma db push (no migration files); generated client is git-ignored.

nodes.label: Redis QueueEvents Cross-instance Fan-out
nodes.rationale: Lets the SSE layer fan processed ticks across horizontally scaled instances.

nodes.label: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL / Aurora Serverless v2
nodes.norm_label: amazon rds for postgresql / aurora serverless v2

nodes.label: Server-Sent Events Item Stream
nodes.rationale: Streams item_submitted / item_processed events; resumable via Last-Event-ID.

nodes.label: SSM Parameter Store / Secrets Manager Config
nodes.norm_label: ssm parameter store / secrets manager config

nodes.label: TH-2 Improvement Plan (Analysis)
nodes.rationale: Separate take-home task kept for reference; unrelated to the H3 Zoom Test app. Improvement plan for a live single-VM SaaS with no version control, manual deploys, no monitoring and a non-technical owner.

nodes.label: h3-zoom-test-api-client Library README
nodes.rationale: Nx-generated library; unit tests via Jest (nx test h3-zoom-test-api-client).

nodes.label: Risk Removed per Unit of Effort Prioritisation
nodes.norm_label: risk removed per unit of effort prioritisation
nodes.rationale: Changes ordered by risk removed per unit of effort, biased toward changes that make the later ones safer.
